summary: Opening the store no longer rescans every sent message, lifecycle claim and mark into the mail delivery ledger: the backfill runs once per file, and the ledger's triggers keep it current after. On a member with 184,589 sent messages and 638,549 lifecycle steps that saves about 9 s of writer time at every start.

replay.detail: No claim kind or replay change.

schema.detail: One member-local meta key, mail_delivery_source_backfilled_v1, records that the backfill ran in this file. No table, trigger or replicated data changes.

rules.detail: No rule or authority change. The ledger holds the same rows: its triggers on claims, marks, stagings and the stream mirror fire whichever build writes, and the backfill covers what predates them.

compatibility.detail: Member-local only; peers see no difference.

downtime.detail: The first open of this build runs the backfill once more, as every open did before (about 9 s on such a member). Later opens skip it.

recovery.detail: Rolling back works as before: the previous release ignores the marker and rescans at each open, as it always did. Upgraded again, this build finds the marker and skips the rescan. The triggers kept the ledger current throughout.
